# Risk Register: Production Inference Endpoint Runtime Migration

**Context:** Migrating a high-traffic production inference endpoint from **Runtime A** (e.g., TensorFlow Serving) to **Runtime B** (e.g., Triton Inference Server or TorchServe).
**Goal:** Zero-downtime migration with no degradation in model quality, latency, or reliability.

| ID | Risk Category | Risk Description | Severity | Likelihood | Detection Method | Mitigation Strategy | Rollback Trigger |
